# `b10x-llm-gateway`

Generated by `llm-gateway-docs` from the clap definition in [`crates/llm-gateway-cli/src/cli.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/llm-gateway/blob/main/crates/llm-gateway-cli/src/cli.rs). `b10x-llm-gateway --help` prints the same text and `b10x-llm-gateway --version` prints the name and the package version.

> The authenticated single-owner llm-gateway, configured by one closed TOML document

```text
Usage: b10x-llm-gateway --config <CONFIG>
```

## Options

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config <CONFIG>` | yes | none | Path to the closed TOML deployment document. |

The command line takes nothing else: a subcommand, a positional argument or another option is a usage error. The document the option names is described in [the deployment document](./deployment-document.md).

## Exit status

| Status | When | Last line on standard error |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | stopped by SIGINT or SIGTERM after every accepted request was answered | `b10x-llm-gateway: stopped by <signal> accepted=<n> completed=<n>` |
| 1 | the start was refused: the document, a file it names, the listen address or the signal handlers | `b10x-llm-gateway: refused <source>:<rule>: <message>` |
| 2 | a usage error, reported by clap | clap's usage message |

While it serves, the process writes `b10x-llm-gateway: listening on <address>` once. `RUST_LOG` sets the level of the structured events it writes beside these lines (default `info`).
